props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations, skipped when the user prefers reduced motion (default `true`)

props.name: deep
props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);
by default the chart updates when a prop is replaced (cheaper on large data)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage or series (shown by default for pie, donut, funnel and multi-series radar charts)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it (default `true`)

props.name: dots
props.description: Dots on the vertices (default `true`)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D (default `auto`, see `setDefaultChartRenderer`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: series
props.description: Polygons `{ name, values }`: one value per indicator

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels (default 8 on every side)

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (default: the chart type, e.g. "Donut chart")

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, compact numbers); the page language by default

props.name: shape
props.description: Grid shape (default `polygon`)

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap nodes, by
index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only emit
`toggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip (default: compact numbers, 1.2k, 3.4M)

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1 (default: one decimal, "40.0%")

props.name: levels
props.description: Number of grid rings (default 4)

props.name: indicators
props.description: Axes of the chart `{ name, max }`, clockwise from 12 o'clock

<script setup lang="ts">
// `shape="circle"` draws round grid rings, `levels` sets how many.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { RadarChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: {
    profile: "Profile",
    skills: ["Frontend", "Backend", "Design", "Testing", "DevOps", "Data"],
  },
  zh: {
    profile: "能力画像",
    skills: ["前端", "后端", "设计", "测试", "运维", "数据"],
  },
  ja: {
    profile: "プロフィール",
    skills: [
      "フロントエンド",
      "バックエンド",
      "デザイン",
      "テスト",
      "DevOps",
      "データ",
    ],
  },
  fr: {
    profile: "Profil",
    skills: ["Front-end", "Back-end", "Design", "Tests", "DevOps", "Données"],
  },
};

const { language } = useI18n();
const text = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const indicators = computed(() =>
  text.value.skills.map((name) => ({ name, max: 10 })),
);
const series = computed(() => [
  { name: text.value.profile, values: [9, 6, 7, 8, 5, 6] },
]);
</script>

<template>
  <RadarChart
    :indicators="indicators"
    :series="series"
    shape="circle"
    :levels="5"
    :height="320"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// One polygon per series, one value per indicator (axes clockwise from 12
// o'clock); the legend hides / shows a series.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { RadarChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: {
    current: "Current model",
    next: "Next model",
    axes: ["Speed", "Reliability", "Comfort", "Safety", "Efficiency"],
  },
  zh: {
    current: "当前型号",
    next: "新型号",
    axes: ["速度", "可靠性", "舒适性", "安全性", "能效"],
  },
  ja: {
    current: "現行モデル",
    next: "次期モデル",
    axes: ["速度", "信頼性", "快適性", "安全性", "効率"],
  },
  fr: {
    current: "Modèle actuel",
    next: "Nouveau modèle",
    axes: ["Vitesse", "Fiabilité", "Confort", "Sécurité", "Efficacité"],
  },
};

const { language } = useI18n();
const text = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const indicators = computed(() =>
  text.value.axes.map((name) => ({ name, max: 100 })),
);
const series = computed(() => [
  { name: text.value.current, values: [72, 85, 64, 90, 58] },
  { name: text.value.next, values: [88, 80, 78, 92, 81] },
]);
</script>

<template>
  <RadarChart :indicators="indicators" :series="series" :height="320" />
</template>

translationResources.title: 雷达图
translationResources.description: 在多个量纲不同的指标上比较一个或少数几个对象（技能评估、产品评测、风味特征）。悬停多边形可高亮它及最近的指标；方向键在系列和指标之间移动，Esc 清除；点击图例项可隐藏系列。

basic.title: 基础
basic.description: 一个系列、六个指标，max 为 10；提示框列出所有数值，并加粗指针下方的指标。

compare.title: 产品对比
compare.description: 三个系列时自动显示图例；onHover 返回当前系列及离指针最近的指标。

circle.title: 圆形网格
circle.description: shape="circle" 绘制圆形网格，levels 设置环数，dots={false} 隐藏顶点；opacity 加深填充。

players.title: 球员对比
players.description: 两名足球运动员的六项能力；指标上的 min 和 max 把每个轴放大到评分有差异的 30-99 区间，每个系列设置自己的颜色。

capabilities.title: 产品能力
capabilities.description: 分析师对我们的产品、竞品和市场平均水平的评分。hidden 让可见性变为受控：复选框和图例（onToggle）共用同一个状态。

nutrition.title: 早餐营养成分
nutrition.description: 三种早餐绘制在圆形网格上（shape="circle"，levels={5}），每条轴以每日参考值的百分比表示。renderTooltip 使用事件的 indicator 列出每份早餐中所悬停营养素的含量。

live-monitor.title: 实时服务监控
live-monitor.description: 当前负载每秒重绘一次（setInterval，在关闭开关或卸载时清除），叠加在过去一小时的基线之上，超过告警阈值时变为红色。只播报负载最高的指标和告警状态，而不是每次刷新。

review-360.title: 360 度评估
review-360.description: 通过 Select 选择要与团队平均值对比的人员；将该人员始终作为第二个系列，多边形就会原地过渡。下方文字指出其相对团队的最大优势和最大差距。

sales-targets.title: 单位各异的销售目标
sales-targets.description: 每个指标都有自己的 min 和 max，因此收入、成交数、赢单率和 NPS 可以共用一张图；目标是未填充的轮廓。onClick 和 renderTooltip 读取事件的 indicator，显示某个 KPI 的实际值、目标和达成率。

RadarChartProps.indicators: 图表的坐标轴，从 12 点钟方向顺时针排列
RadarChartProps.series: 多边形：每个指标对应一个数值
RadarChartProps.shape: 网格形状：多边形或圆形

RadarIndicator.name: 坐标轴名称
RadarIndicator.max: 外圈对应的数值；省略时取各系列中的最大值

RadarSeries.name: 显示在图例和提示框中的名称
RadarSeries.values: 每个指标对应一个数值
RadarSeries.color: 多边形颜色；省略时取自调色板
RadarSeries.opacity: 填充不透明度，取值 0 到 1

basic.title: 基础用法
basic.description: 按住顶点附近即可查看某项技能的得分；format 将得分写成满分 10 分的形式。

compare.title: 对比
compare.description: 圆形网格上的两个系列；hidden 与 onToggle 让图例状态由应用保存。

compare.title: 对比两个系列
compare.description: 两个型号在五个指标上的对比；图例可隐藏或显示系列。

circle.title: 圆形网格
circle.description: shape 设为 circle 时绘制圆形网格环，levels 设置环数。

props.height: 图表高度（包含图例）：像素值或任意 CSS 长度
props.options: 其他引擎选项（坐标轴、图例、提示框、调色板、格式化……），与元素自身的属性合并；仅作为属性设置
props.instance: 引擎实例（minerva-design/charts/core），在元素渲染并连接到文档之前为 null

events.minerva-hover: 悬停（或键盘聚焦）的图形元素发生变化；detail：{ index, name, value, share }，无悬停时为 null
events.minerva-click: 点击、轻触或按 Enter 激活了一个图形元素；detail：{ index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: 点击了图例项（或调用了 toggle()）；detail：{ index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: 按索引隐藏或显示扇区、阶段、雷达系列或树图的顶层节点
methods.getRenderer: 绘制图形所用的后端（webgpu、webgl2、webgl、canvas2d），就绪前为 null；可通过引擎选项 renderer 指定
